question:
Which letter represents the region Bowman's capsule in the diagram below?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c661cd7fc05619908b7cd89373a2bb41be86fee73cefb6cf94e61a463aac39be.png]
solution:
The correct answer is__** Region a.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bowman capsule** is a **cup-like sac** at the beginning of the tubular component of a **nephron** in the mammalian kidney.
 
• It performs the first step in the **filtration of blood to form urine.**
 
• The Bowman capsule surrounds the **glomerulus** and together they form the **renal corpuscle**.
 
• Blood enters the glomerulus through the afferent arteriole and is filtered through the capillary walls into the Bowman capsule.
